native_pack_review.rotation: Exact clockwise transpose; half-open coordinate formulas correct, including corners.
native_pack_review.coverage: Detail tiles cover both context rectangles; 18 reserve grid cells plus those rectangles cover every original pixel. This is geometric coverage, not evidence every mark was annotated.
native_pack_review.code_caveat: coverage() names its covered-target predicate union_equals_target even though arbitrary rectangles outside a target are not rejected. Actual listed context/tile/reserve rectangles are appropriate and bounded, so this naming caveat does not invalidate this pack.

independent_visible_region_inventory.observed_layout: Approximately six horizontal bands, with slanting ascenders/descenders crossing simple row divisions. Final small band lies near the lower card edge. First band is the separately frozen scope.
independent_visible_region_inventory.quality: Most strokes visible at native scale; variable ink density, small final-band writing, watermark overlap, paper/print texture, and joining strokes limit unit boundaries. No global claim that every mark is a cipher symbol.

independent_visible_region_inventory.observed_layout: Six long horizontal manuscript bands in the 90CW view plus a shorter lower inscription-like band and detached marks. Native writing is rotated relative to the bottom block.
independent_visible_region_inventory.quality: Many isolated contours visible, but joining strokes, detached points, watermark overlap and band slant complicate segmentation. Short bottom inscription-like band must be inventoried without imposing cipher status.

independent_visible_region_inventory.observed_layout: Context ROIs overlap here; the same native occurrence can therefore be seen in two packs. Cross-band duplicate candidates require explicit records, never duplicate occurrence counts or visual-family inference.

Viewed in the original image. Central/left illustration, regular translucent circular watermark, paper/card boundary, surrounding white background, and scattered dark surface/print marks. No additional coherent manuscript line observed beyond the two main blocks.
independent_visible_region_inventory.semantic_role: UNKNOWN for ambiguous individual dark marks; illustration/watermark/background are visual context, not glyph evidence.
independent_visible_region_inventory.limit: Context inventory is not pixelwise authentication of every fleck or faint surface mark.

boundary_assessment.bottom: Visible writing fits in bottom context; arrow-like terminal stroke near lower-right and small lowest band approach card boundary but have surrounding original pixels. Inspect original before calling any cut a source defect.
boundary_assessment.right: Right context contains visible block including edge-near final marks; whole original is available for any boundary dispute.
boundary_assessment.firstband: No annotation assessment yet; frozen content must remain exact and any new evidence recorded separately.
boundary_assessment.contour_policy: Approximate contour boxes with +/-4 pixel tolerance are suitable; exact pixel bounds are unsupported.
